n.exclusions: Recruitment 39; movement >2 mm n=10; knowledge below 75% n=0; MRI contraindication n=1; non-compliance n=1. Source explicitly reports final N=23; listed exclusions do not reconcile recruitment to final N. Collinearity led to omission of one functional block for two participants and two blocks for one participant, not stated participant exclusions.
